units.source_text: 一清早起，雨就下个不停。

en.t: From early morning on, the rain kept falling without pause.
By nightfall, it had turned into a torrential downpour.

units.source_text: 晚餐后，我在自己的房间里读书。

en.t: After dinner, I was reading in my own room.

units.source_text: 晚上八点光景，从客殿通往大书院前走廊上传来了脚步声，像是有来宾造访难得不外出的老师的住处。

en.t: Around eight that evening, footsteps came from the corridor leading from the guest hall to the front of the large study, as though a visitor had come to call at the residence of the teacher, who rarely went out.

units.source_text: 但是，那脚步声有点奇异，好似乱雨敲打木板ti的声音。

en.t: But those footsteps sounded somewhat strange, like scattered rain striking wooden boards.

units.source_text: 前边领路的师兄弟的脚步声是稳重而有规律的，

en.t: The footsteps of the senior disciple leading the way ahead were steady and regular,

units.source_text: 而客人的脚步走在底退的旧木板上却发出了异样的吱吱声，且相当的迟缓。

en.t: while the guest's steps on the worn old floorboards made an odd creaking sound and were quite slow.
